reply: Thank you for explaining that your accounts were closed without your knowledge, and that the closing check was reportedly deposited at another bank you never used. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the check details and your dispute number, and ask in writing for a copy of the deposited check and the status of your claim. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that someone changed your online banking password and address, then moved and withdrew about $6,000.00 from your accounts. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the fraud team. Please keep the dates and times of the activity, and report the unauthorized transactions in writing as soon as possible. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your funds are restricted after two incoming transfers from your own account, even though you sent proof of the source. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account security team. Please keep copies of the appeal forms and proof you sent, and ask in writing what else is needed to release the funds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $17,000.00 was transferred from your savings account without your authorization after your card was swapped. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including how your report was handled. Please keep your report details and any police report, and ask in writing for the result of the investigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a savings account was opened in your name without permission and later closed, and that a phone number in your name is not yours. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep your freezes and fraud alerts in place, and report the identity theft so you have a recovery plan. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $350.00 for a service that was never delivered and that your scam claim was denied without a chance to send documents. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written statement with your payment records and messages with the recipient, and ask for the claim to be reconsidered. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you returned a rental car because of a recall and were told you would not be charged, but did not receive the refund. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the recall messages and any return receipt, and ask in writing for the refund of your down payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked to close your account three weeks ago during a difficult time, but it remains open and is causing further problems. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please send a written request to close the account, and ask for confirmation of the closing date and how the small balance will be returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the order of your transactions led to many overdraft fees, and that your account was closed and reported. We understand the effect on your ability to open a new account. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for your transaction history and fee records, and keep your statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cancelled your flights without penalty but only part of your points were returned. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the rewards team. Please keep the booking ID and the cancellation confirmation, and ask in writing for the remaining points and the $150.00 charge to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that paper statements stopped and that you do not receive email statements, leading to two late payments. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please ask in writing for paper statements or email alerts to be set up, and for the late fees to be reviewed. Not receiving a bill does not change the due date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that monthly charges of $41.00 appeared on your card for a plan you never signed up for, and that only some charges were credited. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep a list of each charge and dispute, and ask in writing for the reasons for each decision. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card account was included in your bankruptcy, but late payments or balances are reported after the discharge. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep your discharge order, and dispute the entries with the credit reporting companies, including a copy of the order. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that store credit cards were opened in your names without your knowledge, and that you are being held responsible for purchases you did not make. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please report the identity theft, keep your fraud claim details, and check your credit reports for other accounts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an impersonator obtained your login details and made $7,300.00 in charges and advances on your business cards, and that only $2,500.00 was credited. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep your call records and the date you reported it, and ask in writing for the reasons for the decision on the rest. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you believe an account on your report results from identity theft and that you did not receive the documents you asked for. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please report the identity theft, and dispute the account with the credit reporting companies, including your report. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your credit card was closed after a payment was returned because of fraud on your bank account, even though you quickly repaid it. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep your bank's records of the fraud, and ask in writing for the account closure to be reconsidered. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern that the terms asked for far more personal information and device access than seemed necessary. We understand why this worries you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please keep a copy of the terms you were shown, and ask in writing what information is required and how it will be used. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that information on your credit report is the result of trafficking. We are sorry for what you have been through. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. You can ask the credit reporting companies to block these items, and include any documents you have that support your request. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your disputes are answered within a day as verified, without signs of a full investigation. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a dispute explaining each inaccuracy with supporting documents, and add a statement to your file if you still disagree. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that disputed items on your report have not been corrected despite the evidence you sent. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a new dispute listing each item with copies of your supporting documents, and keep proof of what you sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that an incorrect account on your credit report has caused serious harm. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify the account and explain why it is wrong, and include any supporting documents in your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the same account shows different closing dates from different reporting sources. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the incorrect date with each credit reporting company, including any records that show the correct closing date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that letters about several accounts and inquiries on your report have not led to any changes. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain what is wrong with each account, include supporting documents, and keep proof of when you sent each dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that accounts you never opened appear on your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each account with the credit reporting companies, and report possible identity theft. If you disagree with the result, you can add a statement to your file. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that several accounts on your report have incorrect statuses and payment dates, and that you are concerned about a data breach. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each item, explaining what is wrong and including any supporting records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for asking for an account on your credit report to be checked for accuracy. We understand your concern about its effect on your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain which details you believe are wrong and include any supporting documents in your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your request for validation of a debt you are being contacted about. We understand why you want this information. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your request, and be careful about sharing personal information until the collector has given you the details of the debt. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your signature was used without your consent on a document that led to an account in your name. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep a copy of the document, report the identity theft, and check your credit reports for any other activity you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were contacted about an old card balance you have already paid, and that the caller threatened court action. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your payment confirmation and a note of the call, and send a written dispute stating the balance was paid. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
